% Optically-thin cooling rate
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C7_QR}
Q_R(T, \rho, Z) = n_e\,n_i\,\Lambda(T, Z) \ge 0,\qquadn_e \approx n_i \approx \rho/(\mu_e m_u)
\end{equation}

% Local power-law fit (piecewise)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C7_piecewise}
\Lambda(T) \approx \Lambda_k\,(T/T_k)^{\alpha_k},\qquad T \in [T_k,\,T_{k+1}]
\end{equation}

% Cooling timescale
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C7_tau}
\tau_\mathrm{cool} = \frac{\varepsilon_\mathrm{th}}{Q_R} = \frac{p}{(\gamma-1)\,n_e n_i\,\Lambda(T)} = \frac{1}{(\gamma-1)}\,\frac{\mu_e^2 m_u^2 k_B T}{\mu m_u\,\rho\,\Lambda(T)}
\end{equation}

% Townsend 2009 closed-form update (power-law segment, α ≠ 1)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C7_Townsend}
T(t) = \bigl[\,T_0^{1-\alpha} - C(1-\alpha)\,t\,\bigr]^{1/(1-\alpha)},\qquad C = (\gamma-1)(\mu m_u/k_B)\,n_e\,\Lambda_0/T_0^\alpha
\end{equation}

% α = 1 degenerate limit (logarithmic integrand)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C7_exp}
T(t) = T_0 \exp(-C t)
\end{equation}

% Energy-equation coupling
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C7_energy}
\partial_t E + \nabla\!\cdot\!(\cdots) = -Q_R(T, \rho, Z)
\end{equation}

% Explicit-source CFL (sub-cycle if violated)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C7_CFL}
\Delta t_\mathrm{rad} \le \beta_\mathrm{rad}\,\tau_\mathrm{cool},\quad \beta_\mathrm{rad} \approx 0.1\ (\text{Townsend 2009 guidance})
\end{equation}

% Isobaric thermal instability condition (Field 1965)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C7_field}
\partial_T\Lambda|_p < 0 \ \Longleftrightarrow\ \alpha < 2\ \text{(runaway at } T \in [10^5, 10^6]\,\mathrm{K}\text{)}
\end{equation}
